title: 第1360章 影路第1359章 空灯借命
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
红绳交叉。
黑布盖面。
箱底压着干土。
原本很稳。
可现在，箱角有一点灰红痕。
就是那里出了声。
林凡站在三步外。
九叔站在他左侧。
掌门站在右侧。
顾安纸匣被放在更远处。
不是靠近。
是见证。
外室所有弟子都退开。
不许喊名。
不许说话。
林凡看着无光箱，心里很平。
他没有想七夜。
也没有想七灯还一。
他只看眼前。
一只封箱。

一撮残灰。
一条借口。
断掉它。
掌门抬手。
旁边道长取下一张外层封咒纸。
只取一角。
不揭全。
封纸刚松，箱内立刻响了一声。
咔。
声音很轻。
文才若在这里，肯定又要发抖。
林凡没有动。
箱内又传来一道声音。
“林……”
刚出一个字，九叔眼神一冷。
掌门也要压手诀。
林凡却先开口。
“无可借。”
声音不高。
很稳。
content_en:
Red rope cross.
Covered with black cloth.
The bottom of the box is pressed with dry soil.
It was originally very stable.
But now, there is a little gray and red mark on the corner of the box.
That's where the sound came from.
Lin Fan stood three steps away.
Uncle Jiu stood on his left.
The leader stands on the right side.
Gu An's paper box was placed further away.
Not close.
It's a testimony.
All the disciples in the outer room retreated.
No name calling is allowed.
No talking allowed.
Lin Fan looked at the lightless box and felt very calm.
He didn't think about Qiye.
I didn’t even think about paying seven lights for one.
He only looked at what was in front of him.
A sealed box.
A pinch of ashes.
An excuse.
Break it off.
The leader raised his hand.
The Taoist priest next to him took off a piece of outer sealing paper.
Just take a corner.
Not revealing everything.
As soon as the sealing paper was loosened, there was a sound inside the box.
Click.
The voice is very soft.
If a literary talent were here, he would definitely be trembling again.
Lin Fan didn't move.
Another voice came from inside the box.
"Lin..."
As soon as he said a word, Uncle Jiu's eyes turned cold.
The leader also needs to press the tactics.
Lin Fan spoke first.
"Nothing to borrow."
The voice is not high.
Very stable.
